Internal helper: emit a note to stdout in the package house voice

Source: R/classify.R
dot-jst_msg_out.Rd

The stdout sibling of .jst_msg(): same assembly, same width wrapping, different sink. Some notes belong on stdout rather than the message connection – the status panels, and the note builders that have always printed rather than signalled. Those call this instead of cat() so that they participate in the message.width setting like every other emitter, rather than depending on each builder remembering to wrap its own prose.

Usage

.jst_msg_out(...)

Arguments

...

Message parts, concatenated with paste0().

Value

Invisibly NULL; called for the text it prints.

Details

NOT a general cat() replacement, and deliberately not named as one. The analysis functions render column-aligned tables through cat(); wrapping those would destroy the alignment. This emitter is for prose.

Trailing newlines are normalized away and exactly one is emitted. message() supplies its own line ending and cat() does not, so the call sites converted to this emitter all wrote their own; normalizing means a converted site cannot emit a stray blank line and a new site cannot forget. Leading blank lines are PRESERVED: a builder that opens with one is spacing itself off the output above, which is a layout choice the emitter has no business overriding.
